card.name: Call of the Haunted
card.officialText: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

behavior: Continuous Trap must be face-down in backrow from a prior turn; activation supports own Main/Battle priority or explicit response chain
targets one eligible monster from the activating team's shared Graveyard with TargetBinding zone+epoch
successful resolution Special Summons face-up Attack without changing physical UID/owner and records equippedTo link
if Call of the Haunted leaves field for grave/banished/hand, its linked monster is destroyed by UID even after control change
if the linked monster leaves field by destruction/bounce/banish, the Trap is sent to its physical owner's GY and link is cleared
inactive partner physical ownership routes Trap/monster to the correct shared GY, banished zone or reserve hand
negation, invalid target or full Monster Zone does not summon; source is sent to GY
activationId and equipped link survive JSON; inventory conserved

limitations: Adapter empilhado sobre M564 e ainda não integrado ao resolver v9/catalog registration; carta não certificada nem disponível em decks.
Testes offline; sem gateway/guild Discord real. O engine central deve chamar os dois handlers de saída de vínculo quando cartas deixam o campo.
A janela de resposta é validada por estado explícito; ordenação completa da corrente continua responsabilidade do resolver central.
